thread:
marco: Cutting RC for service-api - sha=efb7c9d. Opening RC now. Planned change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting QA smoke and sherpa coverage for canary.

releng: RC artifact created and pinned. `/deploy create-rc --sha efb7c9d --name rc-efb7c9d-20260321` -> id 4852. Artifacts: service-api:efb7c9d. Promote to canary with `/deploy promote rc/4852 --env canary --kv-warm`.

amy: staging smoke looks fine overall, but saw an auth timeout spike around 18:12 UTC in trace-2. Small repro logs pasted below.

jalex: @amy paste the snippet please so we can triage quickly. tagging @sheriff-ops for visibility.

amy:```text
2026-03-21T18:12:34Z ERROR auth timeout user=1234 trace=abc
2026-03-21T18:12:35Z INFO retrying auth
```

sheriff-ops: I'll cover the promo window. Rollback target pre-approved: service-api:ea9c1b (last known good). Rollback procedure: `kubectl set image deploy/service-api service-api=ea9c1b -n prod` and run /deploy resume --rollback.

marco: releng, make sure the release notes mention the non-migration DB change and KV warm note.

releng: done. Notes: "service-api: prefix cache + migration to v3.3; KV warming recommended; no schema migration." https://redwood.internal/release/4852

marco: promoting to canary now: `/deploy promote rc/4852 --env canary --percent 5`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started rc/4852 -> canary (5%). KV warm in progress (wait 60s).

marco: KV warm reported complete. Watch 95th latency and 5xx rate please.

amy: canary smoke ok for main textgen flow. Error rate small bump 0.3% -> 0.5%.

jalex: hold 10m, if errors exceed 1% sustained for 5m we abort.

marco: starting prod ramp: `/deploy promote rc/4852 --env prod --stages 10,50,100 --wait-metrics`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Prod ramp started: moving to 10%. Notifying oncall.

sheriff-ops: observing a rise in 500s from inference service when traffic enters the 50% stage. Metric threshold hit at 12:03 UTC. Recommend pause and investigate.

marco: pause at 10% now. `/deploy abort-stage rc/4852 --reason "inference 5xx uptick"`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Ramp paused at 10%. Reason: metric(inference_5xx) threshold breached. Options: rollback or debug.

jalex: revert traffic to safer canary variant, run quick grep on traces and check heap metrics.

amy: canary gen logs show JVM GC spikes overlapping the 5xx window. No OOM killed. Uploaded heapdump: s3://ci-artifacts/heapdump-4852.gz

marco: Given GC spike under increased load, prefer rollback for prod. @sheriff-ops please run rollback to pinned tag.

sheriff-ops: executing rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/service-api service-api=ea9c1b -n prod && /deploy resume --target rc/4852 --action rollback`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback initiated. Routing prod traffic back to service-api:ea9c1b. Monitoring healthchecks.

marco: status?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback complete. Prod now running service-api:ea9c1b. Health checks stable, 500s/latency back to baseline.

amy: post-rollback smoke on prod: error rate down to 0.1%, latency back to expected.

marco: adding a short postmortem note: "RC 4852: prod ramp halted due to inference GC spike; rolled back to ea9c1b. Next steps: tune JVM flags, reduce microbatching, re-cut RC after perf fixes." Assigned to @jalex.

jalex: ack. Will open perf ticket and schedule a follow-up RC next week after JVM tuning and bench runs.

marco: thanks all. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
